get.description:
Live and dead message rows, newest first; delivered messages are in
the journal.

The queue's journal after `since`: enqueued, delivered, retried and
dead-lettered, oldest first.

post.description: Requeues every dead letter; they start their attempts over.
Requeues one dead letter by id.
Discards one message, live or dead.

Runs a read-only query from the nearest copy, bounded staleness by
design; the script-guard authorizer applies exactly as it does to
script sql.
Executes a statement through the owner, transactional, single-writer.

get.description:
Instances the directory knows of one class, filterable by name
prefix, always paged, because a per-user class holds one instance
per user. The classes come from the counts endpoint.

delete.description:
Deletion is forget: storage, snapshot and edges are reclaimed,
the name may be recreated later and starts fresh, and there is no
undo. This tombstones; the janitor finishes within a sweep.

Every instance of one class, for dev cleanup; pages through the
directory and tombstones each row.

get.description:
How many instances each user class holds: what the rail renders
before anyone asks for names.

post.description:
One method call on one instance, as a script would make it: through
the object's own lane, serialized with every other call, directory
derivation and alarms running as they always do. Never a side
channel into the file.

This is the shell's write mode, and a person touching live data,
so every call is logged against the account that made it. Naming
an instance that does not exist creates it, admission permitting,
exactly as in a script.

get.description:
Overview of one durable object's private storage; a user class's
file is a SQLite database like any other.

The edges other things hold on this object: who follows it, on
which topic, with what filter, and how far behind the publisher's
event log each durable edge sits. Runtime state, never contract.

The object's key-value state pairs, in key order. The reserved
table is denied to SQL from every direction, so this typed read is
the console's only window on the store face. Read-only: writes go
through the object's methods, like everything else it keeps.

post.description:
A read-only query against one object's storage, from the nearest
copy; the script-guard authorizer applies, so reserved tables stay
out of reach. Writes only ever happen through the object's methods.

One page of the class's directory: the row every object in it
contributes, answered without waking any of them.

A POST because the predicate is a tree, not a query string. The
rows are each object's last saved write, so a listing decides
which objects to call and never substitutes for calling one.

Rebuilds the class's index from what still exists: the placement
store's live identities, and each object's shipping manifest.

The operator's path for damage the background pass cannot reach.
That pass finds classes by listing the blob store, so a class
whose prefix is gone entirely is invisible to it; a name can always
be asked for. Nothing is woken and no object file is opened, so
the cost is one small read per live object.

The verified read over a class's directory. Same query as the
listing; every candidate is checked against its object's settled
state before it is served, so stale rows drop, fresher rows arrive
fresh, and the uncheckable come back flagged rather than missing.

get.description:
Every workflow definition a live contract declares, with the
declared-possible step names the skeleton renders.

The definition's runs, newest first, each with its journal-derived
status; the directory names them, the files answer for them.

post.description:
Starts (or joins) a run; the id is the idempotency key, minted
here when the caller has none.

get.description: One run, whole: status plus the journal the CI view folds.

post.description:
Re-enters a failed run at its failed step with fresh attempts;
everything before it replays untouched.
Delivers a named signal into the run; a parked await resumes.
Cancels the run; children and late signals stay refused.

Ask to be kept posted. Public, because the landing page is where
this is asked and nobody has an account yet.

The reply is the same whether the address was new or already on the
list, so the endpoint cannot be used to test whether someone signed
up.

workflowSteps.description: Step literals found at publish: the declared-possible superset.

publishes.description:
Topics each class publishes: "Class:topic", with "=policy" suffixed
for built-in policies ("self").

lifecycle.description:
Class lifecycle declarations: "Class:expire=30d" for a declared
lifespan, "Class:admit" for a creation gate.

capabilities.description: Derived from the code at publish, never hand-written.

scriptId.description: ID of the script this revision is attached to.

scriptConfig.description:
Config that the project was uploaded with.
This is metadata and is mostly included for CLI to restore revisions intact.

revisionId.description:
New revision ID.
This may be null.

kind.description:
How the platform treats the file; modules are lua source, assets are
served as-is. Defaults to module.

filePath.description:
Path of the file relative to the bundle root; its identity within the
bundle.

content.description: Content of the file, base64 encoded.

contentType.description: Mime type served for assets; informative for modules.

hash.description: blake3 of the content, computed by the store; ignored on upload.

size.description: Content size in bytes, computed by the store; ignored on upload.

entryPoint.description:
Path of the entrypoint file.
This is the first file which is executed by the runtime.

bundle.description: The bundle which will be used.

name.description:
Alias name: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits or single dashes. `live-`
and `r-` prefixes are reserved for routing.

revisionId.description: Revision the alias serves; must belong to the script.

publicIdentifier.description:
Public identifier of the script.
This must be globally unique

lastUpdated.description: Date that the script (or revisions) were last updated.

currentRevisionId.description:
ID of the currently deployed revision.
This is empty for newly created scripts.

projectId.description: Parent project that owns this script.

publicIdentifier.description:
Public identifier of the script.
This will be the globally unique identifier of your script.

hashes.description: blake3 hashes of the files, lowercase hex.

scriptId.description: ID of the script this revision is attached to.

scriptConfig.description:
Config that the project was uploaded with.
This is metadata and is mostly included for CLI to restore revisions intact.

bundle.description:
Content bundle of all files.
This is only present in some responses.

rememberMe.description:
Should the generated token be remembered?
This changes expiration to 60 days from 1 day.

admin.description: If the user is a system admin.

currentPassword.description:
This is only needed if a password is set.
OAuth only accounts or accounts with alternative methods
do not need this.

user.description: User id that the permissions apply to.

ownerId.description: Owner of project, has full access.

region.description:
The project's home region: where its named objects are born and its
directory lives.

moving.description: Whether the project is between homes; calls are refused, retryably, until it settles.

requestsPerSec.description:
Requests a node admits for the project per second, burst of the
same size; 0 is unbounded.

workUnitsPerSec.description: Work units a node lets the project spend per second; 0 is unbounded.

egressAllow.description:
Hosts outbound requests and dials may reach; a leading dot matches
subdomains. Empty admits everything not denied.

egressDeny.description: Hosts refused before the allow list is consulted.

region.description: A region token: one to sixteen of a-z, 0-9 and '-', not starting with '-'.

step.description: marking, draining, copying, flipping, done, failed; empty when the project never moved.

error.description: Set when the step is failed; the move may be started again.

startedAt.description: Unix milliseconds; 0 when the project never moved.

finishedAt.description: Unix milliseconds; 0 while the move runs.

requestsPerSec.description:
Requests a node admits for the project per second, burst of the
same size; 0 is unbounded.

workUnitsPerSec.description: Work units a node lets the project spend per second; 0 is unbounded.

egressAllow.description:
Hosts outbound requests and dials may reach; a leading dot matches
subdomains. Empty admits everything not denied.

egressDeny.description: Hosts refused before the allow list is consulted.

access.description:
Access field names granted to the token (see the acl list shape).
Omitted, the token can manage scripts and kv but not permissions.

name.description: Human label for the token list, e.g. "github deploy".

token.description: The full token. Store it now; it cannot be retrieved again.

tokenPrefix.description: First characters of the secret, to match a held token to its row.

access.description: Access field names to whether the token holds them.

tokenPrefix.description: First characters of the secret, to match a held token to its row.

access.description: Access field names to whether the token holds them.

count.description: Amount of pairs in the namespace.

type.description: The stored value is always text; this names how to read it back.

ttl.description:
Seconds until the pair expires; absent for one that never does.
Declared optional so a generated client does not demand a field
the service omits.

token.description:
Token used to fetch next page.
Not provided on last page.

version.description: Head version; every rotation increments it.

createdMs.description: Unix milliseconds of the head version write.

createdBy.description: User id that wrote the head version.

createdByName.description: Username behind createdBy, when the account still exists; empty otherwise.

declaredBy.description: Public identifier of the live script declaring this name; null is the orphan state, set but reachable by no live revision.

declaredByRevision.description: Revision id the declaration lives in, when declared.

value.description: The plaintext value; encrypted at rest by the secret service and never returned.

createdMs.description: Unix milliseconds this version was written.

createdByName.description: Username behind createdBy, when the account still exists.

deletedMs.description: Unix milliseconds this version was tombstoned by a delete; 0 while live.

inviteOnly.description: Whether this instance requires a code to register.

smtpEnabled.description: Whether invites can be mailed; false means links are copied.

code.description: The one-use code backing the invite.

link.description: The register link the code rides in.

emailed.description: Whether the invite was mailed; false means copy the link instead.

ownerUsername.description: The owning user's name; ownership means full access.

name.description: A region token: one to sixteen of a-z, 0-9 and '-', not starting with '-'.

dataPlaneAddr.description: The region's data-plane ingress, host:port, what other regions forward to.

placementAddr.description:
The region's placement service as the control plane reaches it; a
move lists the project's objects there. Empty for the control
plane's own region, which it reaches by its own setting.

s3Endpoint.description:
The region's own object storage endpoint, when it is not the
control plane's; empty means the control plane's S3 settings reach
the bucket. The access key is shown; the secret never is.
The region's own S3 endpoint with its scheme; omit for the control plane's.

declaredBy.description: Public identifier of a script declaring it; empty when only the directory remembers it.

orphaned.description: Data exists but no live revision declares it; the platform keeps it until it is deleted explicitly.

detail.description: Structured event detail: message id, payload preview, producer, per-attempt error.

requeued.description: How many dead letters were requeued.

type.description: Declared SQLite type; empty when untyped.

declaredBy.description: Public identifier of the script whose code it runs.

createdMs.description: Unix ms of the first claim.

expireAtMs.description: When the platform deletes it if untouched; 0 = never.

deletedAtMs.description: Tombstone time; nonzero is a deletion in progress the janitor is finishing.

alarmDueMs.description: The pending alarm's due time; 0 = none.

nodeId.description: The lease holder; empty = cold, next touch revives.

total.description: Instances matching the filter across every page.

deleting.description: Rows tombstoned by this request; the janitor finishes each one.

kind.description: string, integer, number, boolean or array. The store binds each value as the kind declared, and a filter is checked against it.

hasDirectory.description: Whether the class's current revision declares a directory, so the console offers a search only where one exists.

directoryFields.description: The fields that directory declares, so a filter can be typed against the same set the worker enforces. Empty for a class with no directory, and for one published before fields were declared.

methods.description: The methods the class's current revision declares, by name, so a shell can offer what an instance answers to. Which of them write is not declarable; a read-only session refuses at the call.

method.description: The method to call on the instance.

valueJson.description: What the method returned, as json text; "null" for nothing. Text rather than a typed value because a method returns whatever it returns, and every generated client reads json text the same way (the same convention as condition values and entry fields).

connection.description: Connection edges only: the endpoint connection id.

topic.description: The topic this edge listens on.

filter.description: Equality filter on event data fields, when set.

cursor.description: Last event sequence this edge passed.

lag.description: Undelivered events behind the log head; durable edges only.

nextAt.description: When delivery retries next (unix ms); 0 when not due.

head.description: Newest event sequence in the publisher's log.

type.description: How 'value' parses: the kv typed-pair kind.

value.description: The stored value, as encoded text.

field.description: Field name as the class's directory function returned it; nested tables arrive flattened, so "location.region" is one field.

op.description: eq, ne, lt, lte, gt, gte, one_of, starts_with, contains or exists. one_of rather than in, because in is a Lua keyword.

valueJson.description: The operand, json-encoded: a scalar, an array for one_of, or a boolean for exists.

all.description: Explicit AND, for grouping inside an any.

limit.description: Rows this page may carry; the worker caps it.

name.description: The instance name; what you call to reach the object.

fields.description: Field name to json-encoded value, for the fields this object has. A field the object lacks is simply absent.

cursor.description: Feeds the next page; absent on the last.

building.description: Fields the class has seen but not finished backfilling. A query naming one is refused; this reports the rest so progress is visible rather than a column mysteriously missing.

live.description: Identities the placement store still lists as live.

withoutRow.description: Live objects whose manifest carries no row yet. Not an error: nothing has settled to copy, and a backfill is what covers them.

tombstones.description: Rows retired because the object no longer exists.

held.description: Whether a node did the work. False means another node holds the class and is rebuilding it already.

unverified.description: The row could not be checked against its object and is served anyway, saying so: dropping it would invent the false negative the directory refuses.

cursor.description: Feeds the next page; absent on the last.

building.description: Fields still building; a query naming one is refused.

declaredBy.description: Public identifier of the declaring script.

stepNames.description: Step name literals found at publish: a superset of what may run, rendered as the hollow skeleton.

status.description: completed, cancelled, sleeping, awaiting, running or unstarted.

detail.description: The status detail: due times, awaited signal, reason.

atStep.description: The step or gate the run is at.

kind.description: STARTED, INTENT, RESULT, TIMER, SIGNAL, CHILD, CANCEL, COMPLETED or AMBIENT.

id.description: The run id; the idempotency key. Omitted, the console mints one.

source.description: The chunk to run: any Luau, as typed or pasted. Its return value is the result.

wallSecs.description: Wall budget in seconds; the node caps it.

write.description: Whether the session is in write mode. Off, the chunk still runs, and the vm refuses kv set/delete, database exec and method calls inside it.

valueJson.description: The chunk's return value as json text; "null" for nothing.

output.description: Every print and log line, in order.

error.description: The chunk's own error, when it failed.

wallMs.description: Milliseconds the run took on the node.

connectionClass.description: The declared connection class running the wire.

direction.description: 'inbound' (a client's upgrade) or 'outbound' (dialled by the project).

peer.description: The far side's host, outbound only.

scriptId.description: The script whose revision opened it.

status.description: 'new', 'warm' (holding a vm) or 'hibernated' (wire kept, vm dropped).

follows.description: Edges the connection holds right now.

source.description:
Which surface this came from. Defaults to `landing`, which is the
only one that asks today.

email.description: Address that asked to be kept posted.

createdAt.description: When the address was first recorded.
